- key_parameters: <msw = MSWParam(scales = c(1, 4, 9), nearbyPeak = TRUE, winSize.noise = 500, SNR.method = "data.mean", snthresh = 10) ;; CalibrantMassParam(mz, method = "edgeshift", mzabs = 0.0001, mzppm = 5) ;; MzClustParam(sampleGroups) ;; CentWaveParam(peakwidth = c(20, 80), noise = 5000, prefilter = c(6, 5000), verboseBetaColumns = TRUE) ;; MergeNeighboringPeaksParam(expandRt = 4, minProp = 0.75) ;; ObiwarpParam(binSize = 0.6) ;; PeakGroupsParam(minFraction = 0.85, subset, subsetAdjust = "average", span = 0.4) ;; PeakDensityParam(sampleGroups, minFraction = 0.4, bw = 30, ppm = 10) ;; ChromPeakAreaParam(minMzWidthPpm) ;; SimilarRtimeParam(20) ;; AbundanceSimilarityParam(threshold = 0.7, transform = log2) ;; EicSimilarityParam(threshold = 0.7, n = 2) ;; PercentMissingFilter(threshold = 30, f) ;; RsdFilter(threshold = 0.3, qcIndex) ;; DratioFilter(threshold = 0.5, qcIndex, studyIndex) ;; LamaParama(lamas, method = "loess", span = 0.5, outlierTolerance = 3, zeroWeight = 10, ppm = 20, tolerance = 0, toleranceRt = 20, bs = "tp")>
- alternatives: <MSnbase (older on-disk representation, xcms version 3) vs MsExperiment and Spectra (modern representation, xcms version >= 4) ;; limma for downstream differential abundance analysis ;; MsFeatures package for general MS feature grouping (which xcms extends)>
- when_to_use: <Use when preprocessing untargeted metabolomics data from LC-MS, GC-MS, LC-MS/MS, or direct injection mass spectrometry (FTICR-MS) to identify peaks, align retention times, group peaks into features, fill gaps, and group features.>
- pitfalls: <Default peak detection settings are rarely appropriate; users must visually inspect EICs of internal standards to tune peakwidth and ppm. Setting minProp too low in MergeNeighboringPeaksParam can cause incorrect merging of isomer peaks. Subset-based alignment requires correct/meaningful ordering of samples (e.g., by injection index). Subset operations on XcmsExperiment or XCMSnExp objects can drop adjusted retention times; use applyAdjustedRtime() to write them permanently. EicSimilarityParam is computationally expensive and should be run as the last refinement step.>

workflows.name: direct_injection_ms_preprocessing
workflows.intent: Preprocess direct injection mass spectrometry data (single spectrum per sample, no chromatographic dimension) including peak detection, calibration, and correspondence.
input: mzML_files (mzML/mzXML/CDF files of direct injection MS)
workflows.stages: 1. Load data using readMSData (onDisk mode) ;; 2. Detect peaks in the m/z dimension using findChromPeaks with MSWParam ;; 3. Calibrate peak m/z values using calibrate with CalibrantMassParam ;; 4. Perform correspondence (grouping peaks across samples) using groupChromPeaks with MzClustParam ;; 5. Extract feature definitions and values using featureDefinitions and featureValues ;; 6. Fill missing peaks using fillChromPeaks with FillChromPeaksParam
workflows.code:
library(MSnbase)
library(xcms)
library(MassSpecWavelet)
library(MsDataHub)
register(SerialParam())

mzML_files <- c(
  HAM004_641fE_14.11.07..Exp1.extracted.mzML(),
  HAM004_641fE_14.11.07..Exp2.extracted.mzML(),
  HAM005_641fE_14.11.07..Exp1.extracted.mzML(),
  HAM005_641fE_14.11.07..Exp2.extracted.mzML()
)

grp <- c("ham4", "ham4", "ham5", "ham5")
pd <- data.frame(filename = basename(mzML_files), sample_group = grp)

ham_raw <- readMSData(files = mzML_files, pdata = AnnotatedDataFrame(pd), mode = "onDisk")

msw <- MSWParam(scales = c(1, 4, 9), nearbyPeak = TRUE, winSize.noise = 500, SNR.method = "data.mean", snthresh = 10)
ham_prep <- findChromPeaks(ham_raw, param = msw)

first_file <- filterFile(ham_prep, file = 1)
calib_mz <- chromPeaks(first_file)[c(1, 4, 7), "mz"]
calib_mz <- calib_mz + 0.00001 * runif(1, 0, 0.4) * calib_mz + 0.0001

prm <- CalibrantMassParam(mz = calib_mz, method = "edgeshift", mzabs = 0.0001, mzppm = 5)
first_file_calibrated <- calibrate(first_file, param = prm)

mzc_prm <- MzClustParam(sampleGroups = ham_prep$sample_group)
ham_prep <- groupChromPeaks(ham_prep, param = mzc_prm)

featureDefinitions(ham_prep)
feat_vals <- featureValues(ham_prep, value = "into")

ham_prep <- fillChromPeaks(ham_prep, param = FillChromPeaksParam())

workflows.name: lc_ms_preprocessing
workflows.intent: Preprocess LC-MS data including peak detection, peak refinement, alignment (retention time correction), correspondence (peak grouping), gap filling, quality filtering, and exporting to SummarizedExperiment.
workflows.stages: 1. Load data using readMsExperiment ;; 2. Filter retention time using filterRt ;; 3. Detect chromatographic peaks using findChromPeaks with CentWaveParam ;; 4. Refine/merge neighboring peaks using refineChromPeaks with MergeNeighboringPeaksParam ;; 5. Align retention times using adjustRtime with ObiwarpParam or PeakGroupsParam ;; 6. Group peaks into features (correspondence) using groupChromPeaks with PeakDensityParam ;; 7. Fill missing peaks (gap filling) using fillChromPeaks with ChromPeakAreaParam ;; 8. Filter features based on quality metrics (e.g., RSD, D-ratio, percent missing) using filterFeatures ;; 9. Export results to a SummarizedExperiment using quantify
workflows.code:
library(xcms)
library(faahKO)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(pander)
library(pheatmap)
library(MsExperiment)

cdfs <- dir(system.file("cdf", package = "faahKO"), full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)[c(1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 12)]
pd <- data.frame(sample_name = sub(basename(cdfs), pattern = ".CDF", replacement = "", fixed = TRUE), sample_group = c(rep("KO", 4), rep("WT", 4)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

faahko <- readMsExperiment(spectraFiles = cdfs, sampleData = pd)
faahko <- filterRt(faahko, rt = c(2550, 4250))

cwp <- CentWaveParam(peakwidth = c(20, 80), noise = 5000, prefilter = c(6, 5000))
faahko <- findChromPeaks(faahko, param = cwp)

mpp <- MergeNeighboringPeaksParam(expandRt = 4)
faahko_pp <- refineChromPeaks(faahko, mpp)
faahko <- faahko_pp

faahko <- adjustRtime(faahko, param = ObiwarpParam(binSize = 0.6))

pdp <- PeakDensityParam(sampleGroups = sampleData(faahko)$sample_group, minFraction = 0.4, bw = 30)
faahko <- groupChromPeaks(faahko, param = pdp)

faahko <- fillChromPeaks(faahko, param = ChromPeakAreaParam())

library(SummarizedExperiment)
res <- quantify(faahko, value = "into", method = "sum")

f <- sampleData(faahko)$sample_type
f[f != "QC"] <- NA
missing_filter <- PercentMissingFilter(threshold = 30, f = f)
filtered_faahko <- filterFeatures(object = faahko, filter = missing_filter)

rsd_filter <- RsdFilter(threshold = 0.3, qcIndex = sampleData(filtered_faahko)$sample_type == "QC")
filtered_faahko <- filterFeatures(object = filtered_faahko, filter = rsd_filter)

dratio_filter <- DratioFilter(threshold = 0.5, qcIndex = sampleData(filtered_faahko)$sample_type == "QC", studyIndex = sampleData(filtered_faahko)$sample_type == "study")
filtered_faakho <- filterFeatures(object = filtered_faahko, filter = dratio_filter)

workflows.name: lc_ms_feature_compounding
workflows.intent: Group LC-MS features presumably representing signal from the same originating compound (compounding) based on retention time, abundance correlation, and EIC similarity.
workflows.stages: 1. Load preprocessed data ;; 2. Group features by similar retention time using groupFeatures with SimilarRtimeParam ;; 3. Refine feature groups by abundance correlation across samples using groupFeatures with AbundanceSimilarityParam ;; 4. Refine feature groups by EIC similarity using groupFeatures with EicSimilarityParam ;; 5. Access feature groups using featureGroups
workflows.code:
library(MSnbase)
library(xcms)
library(faahKO)
library(MsFeatures)

xmse <- loadXcmsData("xmse")

xmse <- groupFeatures(xmse, SimilarRtimeParam(20))

library(pheatmap)
xmse <- groupFeatures(xmse, AbundanceSimilarityParam(threshold = 0.7, transform = log2), filled = TRUE)

xmse <- groupFeatures(xmse, EicSimilarityParam(threshold = 0.7, n = 2))

featureGroups(xmse)
